tier: Integrator Free Plan (Okta Workforce Identity developer org)
category: hosted workforce and customer identity and access management (SSO, MFA, universal directory, developer APIs)

free_tier.stated: Okta Integrator Free Plan: a non-production developer org for up to 10 monthly active users; the org does not expire, 5 Workflows, API Access Management, adaptive MFA, lifecycle management and universal directory available, community developer-forum support only; a 30-day free trial is offered for the paid Workforce suites
free_tier.notes: The Integrator Free Plan org deactivates after 90 consecutive days with no user sign-in unless an app is submitted to the OIN; the pricing FAQ states 180 days of inactivity, while the developer org-defaults document states 90 consecutive days, so the two first-party pages disagree. Paid Workforce Identity suites are per user per month billed annually with a USD 1,500 annual contract minimum (Starter USD 6, Core Essentials USD 14, Essentials USD 17); Customer Identity requires an Enterprise base platform at USD 3,000 per month billed annually.

per_object_cap.stated: unverified: no per-user profile or per-object size cap is stated on the pricing, org-defaults, signup or API pages read

retention.stated: unverified: no user-data or event retention period for the Integrator Free Plan org is stated on the pages read
retention.notes: The org deactivates after inactivity (90 days per the org-defaults document, 180 days per the pricing FAQ) unless an app is submitted to the OIN; deactivation is an availability end, not a stated data-retention window.

egress.terms: not applicable: an identity and authentication API; no traffic allowance or egress term is published on the pricing page

interface_detail: REST APIs under {yourOktaDomain}/api/v1, HTTPS only, version in the path (for example https://{yourOktaDomain}/api/v1/users). Access with an OAuth 2.0 access token or an API token; scoped OAuth 2.0 tokens are recommended. API Access Management implements OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect and is available by default in the Integrator Free Plan org for testing; in production it is a paid add-on. Identity Governance request APIs use version v2.
tooling: Okta SDKs, the OIN Wizard and Submission Tester for integrators, Postman collections, or any HTTP client against the Management and Authentication APIs with an OAuth token or API token.
chaining: Non-production SSO, MFA and user directory for building and testing integrations; submitting an app to the Okta Integration Network keeps the free org active and connects it to the enterprise customer base.

limits.value: 10 active users in the Integrator Free Plan org
5 Workflows in the Integrator Free Plan org
100 authentications per minute default rate limit on the Integrator Free Plan (paid plans start at 600 per minute, extendable with DynamicScale)
a unique business sign-up email is required; the same sign-up email cannot be used for multiple orgs and some addresses are ineligible by location or security considerations

limits_note: The free org is non-production only; API Access Management is a paid add-on in production. The vocabulary has no kind for an environment-type restriction, stated in text.
binding_note: The 10-active-user ceiling and non-production-only scope bind first; each additional user past the free org needs a paid Workforce suite, which carries a USD 1,500 annual contract minimum.

identity_cost.detail: The Integrator Free Plan signup form (developer.okta.com/signup) asks for first name, last name, corporate email, department, country or region, state, role selection and agreement to the Integrator Free Plan Agreement; the org-defaults document states a unique business email is required and no card is shown on the signup form. Whether a later activation step asks for a phone number as an authenticator is unverified: behind a sign-up.

reliability_note: A rate-limited request is governed by per-minute buckets; X-Rate-Limit response headers report the ceiling, remaining calls and reset. The free org deactivates after a period of no sign-ins unless an app is submitted to the OIN.
confidence_note: Free-org scope, rate limit and paid entry price are quoted from the first-party pricing page; user count, Workflows cap, sign-up email rule and inactivity deactivation from the first-party org-defaults document; signup fields from the first-party signup page and API access from the first-party API reference. No account was opened, so later signup fields are unverified and the rung stays documented.
